full_judgment: 8. On the other hand Mr Muhammad Shafique Ullah, learned advocate appearing for the opposite parties submits that the petitioners reside in village home and they are aware about the transfer of property in question much earlier and, as such, the instant application filed with inordinate delay should not be condoned as the opposite parties have acquired vested right by long lapse of time. Mr Muhammad Shafique Ullah learned advocate next submits that the applicants having resident of village home sold 2.60 acres of land to Abdul Mannnan on 18-1-2003 and 1.50 acres of land to Mostofa Miah who in turn sold the same to Abdul Mannan by deed of sale dated 17-1-2004 and thereby they sold 4.10 acres of land which they got vide paragraph 6(জ) and 6(ঝ) of the compromise petition and, as such, the instant review application filed with long delay cannot be sustained. Learned advocate further submits that the date of purported knowledge as mentioned in the application for condonation of delay on 27-10-2011 is not at all correct which has been made with a view to rescue themselves from long delay in filing the review application and, as such, the delay should not be condoned. Learned advocate further submits that the petitioners at the instance of developer company have filed the instant review application which defaulted in completing the project as per the agreement entered into by the opposite parties and petitioners and, as such, there is no bonafide in the present application for condonation of delay. Learned advocate also submits that the petitioners have executed an unregistered deed admitting the contents of solenama and also executed and registered a nadabipatra which signifies that the solanama in question is genuine, bonafide and reliable but the petitioners filed the instant application at the behest of the developer company and, as such, the long delay having occurred should not be condoned. Learned advocate averred that the opposite party have initiated arbitration proceeding for the breach committed by the developer company but with a view to forestall the arbitration proceeding, the petitioners have filed the instant review application which is liable to be rejected on the score of long delay.
